must_present.label: Murky standing pools (not cyan flowing river water)
Mangrove / prop-root / vine-oak voxel trees, not generic jungle canopy
Lily pads or equivalent surface cover on swamp water
Low mist/fog particles over swamp coordinates
Stagnant backwater channels (not a desert river)
Placed marsh animals (frog/fox class) in swamp cells
Mud/silt banks at the edges of swamp water

must_not_present.label: Dense jungle rainforest as the swamp itself (mangroves are allowed)
Cactus, dunes, or sandstorm as the swamp
Snow or pine forest as the swamp
Lava, or turquoise coastal ocean, as the swamp water
